words.legend: Posture shares describe the selected trades, not a finding against chance. Red ranges are losses beyond chance; green ranges are gains beyond chance.

value.summary: 393 trade sides of valued trades, 2017–2026. On the day is expected wins gained at the league's own prices; since is wins actually delivered, for trades with two or more seasons played. Showing only trades that bought for now.

value.note: Each trade has two sides, one per team. A team's tier is its rank that day: live once three games are final, else last season's finish, as the archive recorded it.

freshness.note: Frozen historical input; not current league truth

baseline: The league's own posture and window shares in the same seasons; a share is coloured only where it clears chance
method: both sides of every valued trade, cut by standing, window and posture; 1.96 standard-error ranges
howCounted: A team's tier is its rank on the day of the trade: its live standing once three games were final, otherwise the previous season's finish, exactly as the frozen archive recorded it. Contenders are ranked 1 to 10, teams in the hunt 11 to 22, rebuilding teams 23 to 32; the standings run through the archive cutoff 2026-10-06, never today's live table. What a trade did is read from each side's flow: bought for now when it took in more player value than it sent and sent more pick value than it took, built for later the reverse, like for like otherwise. Value is forecast wins on the day; a flow under 0.05 forecast wins counts as even. On the day is the expected wins a side gained at the league's own prices; since is the wins its assets actually delivered against the other side's, for trades with two or more played seasons. Every range is the 95% likely range of the average per trade; a range touching zero is within chance, not a finding.
